title: Intro to Google Sheets
line: Formulas, lookups and a pivot table on a club sign-up sheet.

project.title: A fundraiser tracker
project.brief: Build a fundraiser tracker on your own. Log each donation with a name and a team, look up each team's goal, total the donations by team and chart raised against goal.
checks: At least twelve donation rows with a SUMIF total for each team
A VLOOKUP or INDEX and MATCH pulls each team's goal
A chart compares money raised with the goal for each team

lessons.title: Start a sign-up sheet
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner Google Sheets. Make a new spreadsheet named Club sign-ups, add headers for name, grade, event and paid, enter ten rows and freeze the header row.
lessons.passes: Row 1 holds four headers and is frozen, and ten sign-ups sit below it.

lessons.title: Formulas and cell references
lessons.goal: Teach Google Sheets formulas with the equals sign, cell references, SUM and COUNTA by counting the sign-ups, totalling the money paid and working out the spots left from a cap of 30.
lessons.passes: One cell counts names with COUNTA and another subtracts that count from 30.

lessons.title: Relative and absolute references
lessons.goal: Teach relative and absolute references in Google Sheets by filling a formula down that takes each member's payment away from a club fee kept in one cell locked with $ signs.
lessons.passes: The owed column is filled down and every formula points at the fee cell with $ signs.

lessons.title: COUNTIF and SUMIF
lessons.goal: Teach COUNTIF and SUMIF in Google Sheets by building a summary that counts the sign-ups and totals the money paid for each event.
lessons.passes: Each event has a COUNTIF and a SUMIF, and the counts add up to ten.

lessons.title: Look up a fee with VLOOKUP
lessons.goal: Teach VLOOKUP with an exact match in Google Sheets by pulling each event's fee from an Events tab into the sign-up rows in place of the single club fee.
lessons.passes: Each row gets its fee from an exact match VLOOKUP on the Events tab.

lessons.title: INDEX and MATCH
lessons.goal: Teach INDEX and MATCH in Google Sheets by finding which event meets in a given room on the Events tab, a lookup to the left that VLOOKUP cannot do.
lessons.passes: A formula with INDEX and MATCH returns the event that meets in the chosen room.

lessons.title: Sort and filter
lessons.goal: Teach sorting and filtering in Google Sheets. Sort the sign-ups by event and then by name, then create a filter that shows only the members who still owe money.
lessons.passes: Rows are sorted by event then name and a filter hides everyone who owes 0.

lessons.title: Count with a pivot table
lessons.goal: Teach pivot tables in Google Sheets by making one on a new tab with Event in the rows, Grade in the columns and a count of names in the values.
lessons.passes: A pivot table on its own tab counts sign-ups by event and grade.

lessons.title: Chart the sign-ups
lessons.goal: Teach charts in Google Sheets by turning the event summary into a bar chart with a chart title and axis titles.
lessons.passes: A bar chart plots sign-ups per event and has a chart title.
